svg.data-power-adapter-nominal: 12 V and 10.8 A, the brochure's "Power adapter nominal voltage" and "nominal current": the adapter's nominal figures, not the box's input
svg.data-power-rating-label: 100-240 V ~2 A MAX, 50/60 Hz (printed under each inlet)
svg.data-m2: one M.2 slot (brochure), not on either face
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: brochure: four 10G SFP+ ports; the brochure prints no list of optics, so none is claimed beyond the cage
